description: One part from the catalogue by slug, as JSON: name, brand, part number, description, category, an available vendor price (lowest offer in one currency, USD when available, e.g. 'from 4.5 USD'), pinout and a link to its Schematik page. Brand, part number, description, price and pinout can be null when unavailable.

slug.description: The part's slug as returned by search_parts, e.g. 'bme280-i2c-sensor'.

name: get_part
